Select relevant columns from lancaster dataset
```{r}
lanc <- lanc %>% select(Word, Auditory.mean:Torso.mean) %>% 
  mutate(Word = tolower(Word)) %>%
  rename_with(~ str_remove(.x, "\\.mean"), Auditory.mean:Torso.mean)  
```

Rerun Sidhu's candidate word dataset to get the sound arousal **coefficient**

```{r}
library(data.table)

d <- as.data.table(read.csv("sidhu_2026_candidate_words.csv"))

#make all entries for IPA binary numeric
preds <- colnames(d[,4:59]) # cols 4 - 59 are the IPA alphabet for each word, coded 1 (present) or 0 (absent)
d <- d[,(preds) := lapply(.SD, as.numeric), .SDcols=preds]

# Count total number of phonemes in each word
d$TotalPhon <- rowSums(d[,6:49])

# Generating the total sound score from Sidhu et al (2026) Exp 1 analysis 
d$TotalSoundScore <- (d$i*0.01707945) + (d$ɪ*0.01764314) + (d$u*-0.04946283) + (d$ʌ*0.05863765) + (d$ɔ*-0.02766362) + (d$k*0.15008612) + (d$l*-0.10463245) + (d$m*-0.09955079) + (d$n*-0.08731275) + (d$p*0.03528270) + (d$t*0.01273982) + (d$ʃ*0.04798239) + (d$oʊ*-0.05648519) + (d$ʧ*0.23973549)

# Calculate average sound score 
d$AverageSoundScore <- d$TotalSoundScore/d$TotalPhon

# z-score emotion ratings (Warriner) and sound scores 
d$zSound <- scale(d$AverageSoundScore)
d$zMeaning <- scale(d$Arousal_Warr)
d$zValence <- scale(d$Valence_Warr)
d$zValenceEx <- scale(d$Valence_Extremity_Warr)
```

```{r}
# select relevant vars 
word_list <- d[, c(1,50:60, 63:66)]

# Thresholds for emotion meanings, based on Sidhu (2026)
sound.cut = 1.25
meaning.cut = 1.25

# Calm Meaning + Calm Sound (less than -1.25) 
word_list[zMeaning < -meaning.cut & zSound < -sound.cut, Type := "CMCS"]

# Calm Meaning + Exciting Sound 
word_list[zMeaning < -meaning.cut & zSound > sound.cut, Type := "CMES"]

# Calm Meaning + Neutral Sound 
word_list[zMeaning < -meaning.cut & zSound <= .25 & zSound >=-.25, Type:= "CMNS"]

# Exciting Meaning + Exciting Sound 
word_list[zMeaning > meaning.cut & zSound > sound.cut, Type := "EMES"]

#Exciting Meaning + Calm Sound
word_list[zMeaning > meaning.cut & zSound < -sound.cut, Type := "EMCS"]

# Exciting Meaning + Neutral Sound 
word_list[zMeaning > meaning.cut & zSound <= .25 & zSound >=-.25, Type:= "EMNS"]
```

```{r}
# Check

# Derived Congruency score from calculated zSound and zMeaning 
word_list[, Iconicity := zSound*zMeaning]

# Make column for Congruency 
word_list[Type == "CMCS" | Type == "EMES", Congruency := "Congruent"]
word_list[Type == "CMES" | Type == "EMCS", Congruency := "Incongruent"]
word_list[Type == "CMNS" | Type == "EMNS", Congruency := "Neutral"]

#Check average for Congruent vs Neutral groups 
word_list[, .(.N, mean(Iconicity), sd(Iconicity)), by = Congruency]
```

Congruent words: *N* = 308, mean_iconicity = 3.10, SD_iconicity = 1.27
Neutral words: *N* = 557, mean_iconicity = 0.01, SD_iconicity = 0.28
Incongruent words: *N* = 221, mean_iconicity = -2.79, SD_iconicity = 0.97

Remove non-sorted rows 
```{r}
word_list_select <- word_list[Congruency == "Congruent" | Congruency == "Incongruent" | Congruency == "Neutral"]
word_list_select$Congruency <- as.factor(word_list_select$Congruency)
```

Select relevant columns from sidhu dataset
```{r}
# Select relevant columns from sidhu data frame
sidhu_list <- word_list_select %>% 
  select(Word, Type, Valence_Extremity_Warr, Arousal_Warr, Iconicity)
```

Join Lancaster and Sidhu datasets 
```{r}
df <- reduce(list(sidhu_list, lanc), inner_join, by = "Word")
nrow(df)
```


Divy up the Types of words (EMES, CMCS, EMNS, CMNS)
```{r}
emes <- df %>% 
  filter(Type == "EMES") %>%
  select(-Word, -Type, -Valence_Extremity_Warr, -Arousal_Warr)
cmcs <- df %>%
  filter(Type == "CMCS") %>%
  select(-Word, -Type, -Valence_Extremity_Warr, -Arousal_Warr)

emns <- df %>%
  filter(Type == "EMNS") %>%
  select(-Word, -Type, -Valence_Extremity_Warr, -Arousal_Warr)
cmns <- df %>%
  filter(Type == "CMNS") %>%
  select(-Word, -Type, -Valence_Extremity_Warr, -Arousal_Warr)

```

Match the row numbers
```{r}
n_match <- min(nrow(emes), nrow(cmcs), nrow(emns), nrow(cmns))
# 120 rows 

# Arrange by desc Iconicity - get top 120 rows from each group 
emes <- emes %>% 
  arrange(desc(Iconicity)) %>%
  slice_head(n=n_match) %>%
  select(-Iconicity)

emns <- emns %>% 
  arrange(desc(Iconicity)) %>%
  slice_head(n=n_match) %>%
  select(-Iconicity)

cmcs <- cmcs %>% 
  arrange(desc(Iconicity)) %>%
  slice_head(n=n_match) %>%
  select(-Iconicity)

cmns <- cmns %>% 
  arrange(desc(Iconicity)) %>%
  slice_head(n=n_match) %>%
  select(-Iconicity)
```

```{r}
net_emes <- estimateNetwork(emes,
  default = "EBICglasso", 
  corMethod = "cor_auto",
  tuning = 0.5)

net_cmcs <- estimateNetwork(cmcs,
  default = "EBICglasso", 
  corMethod = "cor_auto",
  tuning = 0.5)

net_emns <- estimateNetwork(emns,
  default = "EBICglasso", 
  corMethod = "cor_auto",
  tuning = 0.5)

net_cmns <- estimateNetwork(cmns,
  default = "EBICglasso", 
  corMethod = "cor_auto",
  tuning = 0.5)
plot(net_emes, layout="circle", label.scale = FALSE, title = "EMES Network")
plot(net_cmcs, layout="circle", label.scale = FALSE, title = "CMCS Network")
plot(net_emns, layout="circle", label.scale = FALSE, title = "EMNS Network")
plot(net_cmns, layout="circle", label.scale = FALSE, title = "CMNS Network")

```
